title: Decide how the Test Machine line treats parked waiters and holders
text: The host waiting line grants turns strictly in queued order to any waiter whose session has not ended. Two operator decisions remain open: whether a parked or otherwise held waiter is skipped when the host is granted, and whether a holder parked at a human gate keeps the host. Until decided, a parked waiter receives its reserved turn and keeps it until it acquires, releases it or its session ends.
